claims.evidence: BSG is barley spent grain; PRIDE organisms list barley and Rhizopus arrhizus. Column is single-valued: barley used for all rows (inferred); fungal biomass in F-BSG is not captured here.

claims.value: germinated grain; mycelium (second column, F-BSG rows only)
claims.evidence: PRIDE organismParts BTO:0003365 germinated grain, BTO:0001436 mycelium; assignment of mycelium to F-BSG rows is inferred from fermentation by R. oryzae.

claims.value: BSG/F-BSG biomass lysate x3, BSG/F-BSG protein extract x3, F-BSG 20/40/90 h x2
claims.evidence: Run names and mzTab ms_run lists; paper: MS on BSG, F-BSG, BSG protein extract, F-BSG protein extract, and F-BSG sampled at 20, 40, 90 h in biological duplicates. Mapping LyseExtract=biomass lysate and AcidPrec_Product=protein extract is inferred from names and paper.
Paper: samples taken after 20 h, 40 h and 90 h; run names F-BSG_20h/40h/90h

claims.value: SSF with Rhizopus oryzae, 30 C, 90% humidity, pH 5.5, forced aeration

Fermented BSG vs non-fermented BSG; 'control' for unfermented is an inferred label
MaxQuant digestion set to trypsin, 2 missed cleavages. PreOmics iST digestion enzymes not named in deposit/paper, so no second (Lys-C) column.
